metadata.case_name: TSUI WAI HO v. PRIDE GLORY LTD FORMERLY T/A ZITI’S

plaintiff.occupation_before: clerk in a social service organization
plaintiff.occupation_after: assistant clerical officer (ACO) at the Death Registry of the Immigration Department
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: continue working as an ACO if possible
plaintiff.education_level: Higher diploma in accounting (completed Aug 2016); studied up to Form 5

source: X-ray left ankle revealed fracture distal fibula.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: tenderness, bruises and swollen left ankle
limited range of movement of left ankle
mild pain in left leg from time to time, especially when there is a change of weather

treatments_received: open reduction and internal fixation of left ankle fracture (operation on 4 Sept 2013)
removal of left ankle implant (operation on 24 Jul 2015)

losses.description: limited range of movement in left ankle
handicap in the open market in jobs requiring prolonged walking and/or strenuous exertion

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Mok Yau v. 黃吉利 and Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: right ankle fracture treated conservatively by cast; required 424 days of sick leave; almost 2 years after accident still had moderately reduced range of movement

comparable_cases.case_name: Lam Kam Fai v. Yau Shing Scaffolding Co Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: left ankle fracture with surgery and removal of implant; fracture healed with full range of movement; claimant had a pre-existing old injury to left ankle and court applied a 10% discount

comparable_cases.case_name: Leung See Ning Clara v. Shun Tak Property Management Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: left ankle fracture; open reduction and internal fixation; implant removed 2.5 years after accident; occasional mild pain on follow-up about 3 months after accident

comparable_cases.case_name: Kwong Wan Kau v. Yuen Wing Hong
comparable_cases.injury_description: right ankle fracture; operation with metal implants; hospitalized for 11 days; physiotherapy for more than one year and occupational therapy about 14 months; implant removed 6 months after accident; sick leave for more than 3 years
